story.text: 말없이 왜 자꾸 여기저기 궁금해해요. 오늘은 또 뭐가 궁금한 건데요.
story.reading: mal-eobs-i wae ja-kku yeo-gi-jeo-gi gung-geum-hae-hae-yo. o-neul-eun tto mwo-ga gung-geum-han geon-de-yo.
story.en: Why are you always curious about everywhere without saying a word. What are you curious about today.

story.text: 이 '벽화' 마을, 골목마다 그림이 달라요. 천천히 보고 가요.
story.reading: i 'byeok-hwa' ma-eul, gol-mok-ma-da geu-rim-i dal-la-yo. cheon-cheon-hi bo-go ga-yo.
story.en: In this 'mural' village, every alley has a different painting. Take your time looking around.

story.text: 이 '골목' 안쪽으로 가면 사람도 적고 조용해요.
story.reading: i 'gol-mok' an-jjog-eu-ro ga-myeon sa-ram-do jeok-go jo-yong-hae-yo.
story.en: If you go further into this 'alley', there are fewer people and it's quiet.
...You've had a lot of 'questions' since earlier. Why is that, today especially.

story.text: …그 '대답', 지금 꼭 들어야 돼요? 나중에 하면 안 돼요?
story.reading: …geu 'dae-dap', ji-geum kkok deul-eo-ya dwae-yo? na-jung-e ha-myeon an dwae-yo?
story.en: ...Do you really need that 'answer' right now? Can't it wait for later?

story.text: 우리가 무슨 '사이'냐고요? …그건 제가 묻고 싶은 말이에요.
story.reading: u-ri-ga mu-seun 'sa-i'nya-go-yo? …geu-geon je-ga mut-go sip-eun mal-i-e-yo.
story.en: What kind of 'relationship' are we, you ask? ...That's exactly what I want to ask you.

story.text: 그래서, 나한텐 언제 궁금해할 건데요. …답 안 해도 돼요, 표정 보니까 알겠어요.
story.reading: geu-rae-seo, na-han-ten eon-je gung-geum-hae-hal geon-de-yo. …dap an hae-do dwae-yo, pyo-jeong bo-ni-kka al-get-seo-yo.
story.en: So, when are you going to be curious about me. ...You don't have to answer, I can tell from your face.

words.example_en: There are many pretty murals in this alley.
I walk along the narrow alley.
If you have a question, ask me.
I couldn't answer and just smiled.
What kind of relationship are we?

sentences.en: There's a mural in every alley.
This mural village has pretty alleys.
